name: Mei Lin
bio:
Mei Lin's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. While pursuing her degree in Human Resources at Tsinghua University, a guest lecture by a Ferrari executive sparked an unexpected passion. Intrigued by the high-pressure, globally-integrated environment of Formula 1, she redirected her career aspirations towards the racing world.

Mei landed an internship with Ferrari's Shanghai office before transitioning to Maranello. She believes in fostering a positive, yet rigorous, work environment where every team member is challenged to reach their full potential. Mei is known for her meticulous approach to talent acquisition and her commitment to building a diverse and inclusive team.

Her unique approach involves a data-driven analysis of team dynamics, ensuring that new hires not only possess the required skills but also complement the existing team's personality and working style. This focus on overall harmony is what sets her apart from other HR managers.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair with subtle highlights, often worn in a high ponytail.
physical.description: Mei is petite with a focused and intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small jade pendant for good luck.
Insists on using traditional Chinese tea ceremonies to de-stress during high-pressure situations.
Has a habit of meticulously color-coding all her documents and files.
